notes.title: Daily Rides - Scoring Changes
notes.notes:
Hey Riders, 

We have some mid-season news about the daily rides. We often hear feedback from riders who play regularly but aren’t able to reach the high-level rewards. So we decided to update the score distribution.

As long as you finish the daily ride you will receive 400 points. If you rank higher than 190 you will receive more points depending on your rank. This change should make it possible for everyone to reach high-level rewards when you're playing regularly. 

We hope you continue to have a great season! 

Your Megagons

PS: This is just a change in our backend. You don't need to download an update.

notes.title: Major Update - Daily Ride Modifiers introduced with season 7: Summer Strolls
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Riders[/h1]

Lots of new things going on this season. We have just released a major update to the game which introduces modifiers to the Daily Rides! We start today with the “Changed Checkpoints” modifier which changes and adds new checkpoints to the trail. More modifiers and different combinations will be introduced in the course of the new season: Summer Strolls. We wish you a lot of fun with the new feature and please let us know what you think of it.

You can check out this video to see some of the modifiers that await you this season:

[previewyoutube=eLZAlR1CaWQ;full][/previewyoutube]

If you have any questions or ideas for further modifiers please let us know in the forum or our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/lonelymountains

Also congratulations to everyone who participated in the last season and especially to all riders who made it into the Top 25!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/b44468bff81b84cbcbf2759ae794a511690753c2.jpg[/img]

The new Daily Rides Season 7: Summer Strolls is already in full swing and besides introducing the Daily Ride modifiers also adds some beach-life outfits and accessories to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/4c1fd9ceafa6abc64e2ec12f78d38ecf6b9a8e74.jpg[/img]
We hope you have a good time with the new modifiers and we wish you all a great new season!

The Megagons

Jan & Daniel & Noah

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Riders![/h1]

We just released version 1.0.4 and this updates brings quite a lot of changes to the game. Let us briefly walk you through the major ones. 

[u][b]New Bike Part System:[/b][/u] Nearly every review we read over the past 4 months criticized that it takes too long to unlock new bikes and from what we gathered most of the community seemed to agree with that. So we changed the system that bike parts are not bound to a specific bike anymore. Instead each bike costs a certain amount of parts and you can freely decide in what order you want to unlock them. 

[b]IMPORTANT: This means that if you start the game now you won’t have any other bikes  unlocked anymore but you will have all the parts you already collected. You can use these parts to repurchase your bikes (or even different ones) in the bike selection![/b]

[u][b]Easier Progression System:[/b][/u] Until this moment you needed to overcome every challenge in a category in order to unlock the next one. We know that this system blocked a lot of content for some players. Therefore from now on the free ride category of a trail gets also unlocked after finishing the beginner category. The challenges stay the same , so nothing gets easier per se but it allows players to try the free ride mode without having to do all the bike challenges first. 

[u][b]Balancing Changes:[/b][/u] We also made some smaller changes concerning the difficulty of some challenges. You can see the full list down below. 

[b]CHANGE LOG 1.0.4[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New Part System: [/b]Parts can now be freely spent on any bike. [b]ATTENTION: You need to repurchase your bikes with your already collected parts![/b]
[b][*] Challenge System Changes: [/b]All challenges in all categories are now available after crossing the finish line. 
[*] [b]Bike Icons and Finish Line display:[/b] Each bike is now represented by an its own icon and you can see with which bike you already finished a trail. 
[*] [b]Daily/Weekly/Monthly Best-Time Display:[/b] If you cross the finish line you will now see if you achieved a daily, weekly or monthly best-time.  
[*] [b]Customization:[/b] The customization menu is now also available from the bike selection.
[*] Fixed missing checkpoint on Mount Riley/Trail 3 map.  
[*] Fixed "rider surfing in midair on resting spot" bug.
[*] Fixed "locked bike" problem although no bike challenges was selected.
[*]Improved water shader with moon and bike light reflections
[*]Several smaller bugfixes and performance optimizations.
[u][b][*]Balancing Changes: Several smaller balancing changes:[/b][/u][list] [*] [u][b]Graterhorn/Trail 02:[/b][/u]
[*] Increased time for Easy Trail challenge from 180 to 190 seconds.
[*] Increased time for Hard Paint Job 1 Challenge from 135 to 145 seconds
[*] Increased time for Hard Bike Part Challenge from 115 to 125 seconds
[*] Increased time for Hard Paint Job Challenge 2 from 125 to 135 seconds
[*][u][b]Graterhorn/Trail 04:[/b][/u]
[*]Increased time for Hard Outfit Challenge from 85 to 90 seconds
[*]Increased time for Hard Paint Job Challenge from 95 to 100 seconds
[*]Decreased crash amount for Night Easy Challenge to 18
[*][u][b]Redmoor Peaks/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Increased time for Easy Bike Part Challenge from 200 to 210 seconds
[*][u][b]Redmoor Peaks/Trail 04[/b][/u]
[*]Increased crash amount for Night Easy Challenge from 9 to 21
[*][u][b]Sierra Rivera/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Outfit and Trail challenge
[*][u][b]Sierra Rivera/Trail 02:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Bike Part and Trail challenge
[*][u][b]Mount Riley/Trail 01:[/b][/u]
[*]Switched time and crash goals for Easy Bike Part and Trail challenge
[*]Fixed bug that freeride challenge was a time challenge and not just a finish line challenge
[/list]
[/list]
We’re looking forward to your feedback to the new changes. In case you have any questions or want to discuss the changes with the community feel free to hit us up on the official Discord Server: https://discord.gg/lonelymountains

Have a great ride!

Jan & Daniel & Noah

PS: In case you’re reading this but you’re playing on a different platform than Steam please be aware that updates for consoles will from now on follow a week or two after the Steam update due to the longer submission process.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 released
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Riders,[/h1]

we just released version 1.0.1. This update focuses mainly on leaderboard optimizations, convenient features, UI-improvements and bug-fixes. 

Thanks for all your positive feedback, input and bug-reports during the last week. Please keep it coming. 

If you encounter an issue during the game we would highly appreciate it if you can send us the output_log.txt to support@lonelymountains.com. 

You can normally find it at: "C: ->Users ->YOURUSERNAME ->AppData ->LocalLow ->Megagon Industries ->LonelyMountains_Downhill" 

Thank you all for your support!

Daniel & Jan & Noah

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30570088/c8575fcd4603c45584618cfc730824e8b2d202a6.png[/img]

[h1]Detailed Changes:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Optimized various things in regards to the leaderboard connection
[*] Added an option that you can now change the in-game best-time display from global to personal
[*] Added a display that shows the difference of the current cp-time compared to the selected best-time when crossing a checkpoint.
[*] Added a warning to checkpoints in case you skipped a previous one
[*] Added a Discord button to the start menu 
[*] Added a “controller recommended” message to the start menu 
[*] Added a back-button to the pause menu
[*] Added an option to turn off screen shake in the game settings
[*] Added an option to the display settings to keep the game running in the background or when not in focus
[*] Fixed missing tree trunk mesh on Mnt Riley / Trail 2 / Waterfall Section
[*] Fixed a bug that Korean texts were not displayed in the world.
[*] Fixed a bug that backer message achievements were switched in Steam
[*] Changed the mountain number in the mountain selection from unlocked mountains to total mountains
[*] Added an additional lock icon to locked bikes in the bike selection
[*] Highscore-button won’t be displayed in the result screen anymore for the explorer mode
[*] Lots of screen-transitions can now be canceled earlier
[*] Fixed a bug that “New”-notifier in the mountain selection did not fade out correctly when going to the trail screen.
[*] Fixed several smaller localization bugs
[*] Fixed wrong value for “max drop height” statistic
[*] Moved “take a break” button to the center of the screen
[*] Leaving a resting place is now on ESC/B/Circle
[*] Switched “Left/Right” & “Screen-based” buttons in the steering selection pop up. 
[*] Updated Game Launcher banner.
[/olist]
[h1]Known Patch Issues:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Some translations are missing for the new features
[/olist]
